message.content: {"checks":[{"scenario":"REQ-7.1#1","requirement":"REQ-7.1","title":"Add to Recently Viewed","category":"navigation","rationale":"Verify that opening a shelf details page records it in My Recently Viewed on the authenticated homepage.
